concerns.text: The regression design treats all ten genre‑proportion variables as separate predictors while also including `total_minutes` as a covariate. Because each proportion is defined as `genre_minutes / total_minutes`, the set of proportions is compositional (they sum to 1) and is mathematically dependent on `total_minutes`. Including both the full set of proportions *and* `total_minutes` creates deterministic multicollinearity, leading to a singular design matrix and invalid OLS estimates.

Using all ten genre‑proportion predictors simultaneously violates the independence assumption of linear regression: the proportions are constrained (they sum to 1), so they are linearly dependent. The plan only mentions VIF‑based dropping after detection, but this reactive approach may fail (the model may not even fit). A principled solution (e.g., drop one reference genre, use log‑ratio transforms, or apply compositional data analysis techniques) should be specified up‑front.
